questions.explanation: The 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1992 added Part IX to the Constitution, titled 'The Panchayats', effectively institutionalizing the Panchayati Raj system at the village, intermediate, and district levels. (The 74th Amendment dealt with Municipalities).
